text:
maria: quick publish — i ran smoke + canary benches for Sylph-14B on the canary cluster (canary-pool-3). uploading summary here and attaching logs.
lee: nice, can you paste the exact bench command and flags?
maria: sure — command used:
```
bench-run --model sylph-14b --variant fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --kv-cache enabled --quant none --tokens 20000 --clients 16 --warmup 2000
```
maria: canary used three replicas, steady-state run ~5m each. baseline (prod ref: zephyr-6b) comparisons are in the artifact link.
perf-bot: CANARY RESULT: sylph-14b fp16 — status: PASS (no perf regression >10% on p95). artifacts://canary/1723456789
oz: what variants did you try? any int8/q4 runs?
maria: variants tested: sylph-14b.fp16, sylph-14b.q4_0 (int4-ish), sylph-14b.q8_1 (int8 proxy). int8 shows ~6-8ms p50 increase but 2.4x token/sec cost improvement on our infra.
maria: quick CSV snippet from prometheus export:
```
metric,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_per_gpu_s
sylph-14b.fp16,28,120,1800
sylph-14b.q8_1,34,145,4200
sylph-14b.q4_0,40,160,5200
```
lee: p95 jump for q4 looks a bit high vs fp16 — was batching behavior different? what was target_batching_policy?
maria: batching policy = conservative (max_batch 16, max_delay_ms 8). when quantized we saw slightly wider seq-length distribution due to tokenization differences, caused more KV misses early in runs.
judy: any tail latency alerts during the run? did oncall see anything?
perf-bot: ALERTS: none triggered. infra logs show a single transient OOM on replica-2 during warmup (recovered), no sustained errors.
ev an: can you link the flamegraphs / perf traces? want to check kernel time vs scheduler wait.
maria: uploaded traces: artifacts://canary/1723456789/traces.tar.gz — flamegraphs show 60% time in attn_kern, 20% in kv-copy, 10% sys overhead.
oz: recommend we try smaller max_delay_ms for q4 run (e.g., 4ms) and re-run; also try prefill batching knob to reduce kv-copy churn.
lee: agree — also add a short-run with seq 256 to see short-context perf shape.
maria: will re-run quick variants monday morning and open a perf ticket with artifacts + recommended knobs. tagging @evan for canary->staging rollout decision.
ev an: looks ok to me, please create rollout PR with model-variant mapping and fallback policy. if p95 stays within 20% we can enable canary traffic 5% -> 25% across next 48h.
maria: thanks — i'll post results once re-runs complete. :thumbsup:
